connector.name: Cms by uxbert.ai
connector.registryDescription: UXBERT Labs headless CMS: model, write and publish bilingual content, media, delivery checks.
connector.summary: Hosted at cms-mcp.uxbert.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.uxbert, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <management API key> — minted per space in the CMS admin under Space → API keys
